'''Hael Phirce''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] member of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] and served under [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Barden Golah]] while trying to [[Reclamation Service Tatooine expedition|find]] an abandoned [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka]] Base on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. During an expedition to [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]], he was at one point buried alive, yet was eventually rescued. [[Darth Silthar]] had a great affection for Phirce, and in the aftermath of Silthar's death and the incident with the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] technology found by Czerka, Silthar's final request saw Phirce reassigned to [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]].
